thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT  dedicated pool 'sparrow-opaque' hit capacity for tenant Sparrow Labs (tenant=tnr-501). Request queue increasing and GPU attach errors from autoscaler. Paging oncall @maya.

maya: oncall ack, pulling up graphs and logs.

jess: seeing the autoscaler error in control plane: 'AttachFailed: permission_denied: iam:CreateAttachment'. Looks like the cloud account couldn't attach additional GPUs due to recent role change.

rafael: confirmed. We rolled through a permissions hardening earlier today; a role condition inadvertently removed autoscaler service principal from the attach role for some reserved pools.

maya: customer reported timeouts in support ticket. Current state: pool size 6 GPUs, gpu_util ~98%, queue 520, avg_latency 2.1s. Immediate mitigation options: 1) temporarily lower concurrency by applying rate-limit at edge; 2) offload low-priority batch routes to our hosted shared endpoints (need acct approval); 3) perform manual emergency attach by granting perms or moving VMs into pool (longer).

li: rate-limit quick patch: set tenant concurrency limit to 250 and enable queue-shed for excess. That would reduce pending queue and avoid timeouts but will increase client-side retries.

ops-bot: suggested command:
```
rctl throttles set --tenant tnr-501 --concurrency 250 --policy shed
```

tina (acct): talking to Sparrow now. They say dataset is sensitive and cannot go to hosted shared endpoints. They can pause their nightly job for up to 20 minutes but are worried about job time window. Prefer we add capacity within their dedicated pool.

jess: granting attach perms is fastest. Rafael, can you rollback the role condition? Risk: re-opened permission scope for autoscaler service.

rafael: I can temporarily add the autoscaler principal to the attach role for pool-sparing group. Will do with tightly scoped time window (30m). Need verbal ok from SRE lead.

maya: I approve temporary role change for emergency (30m). Postmortem action to add automated guardrail to block this config drift for reserved pools.

rafael: applying change now. Exec log:
```
azcli iam role update --role attach-pool --add-principal svc-autoscaler@infra --condition "expires=2167902911"
```

incident-bot: ACTION brs-2167901111: role update initiated.

jess: autoscaler retried and now shows attach success. Pool increased to 8 GPUs. Observed util drop and queue fall: queue 120 -> 20 over 3 minutes.

maya: confirming metrics:
```
pool: sparrow-opaque
before: gpus=6 queue=520 util=98%
after: gpus=8 queue=18 util=72% avg_latency=320ms
```

tina (acct): Sparrow support: relieved. They paused their job for 10 minutes while we fixed. They want a brief customer-facing summary and assurance this won't become recurring.

li: immediate next steps: (1) revert role change after 30m window (rafael will run), (2) add alert when autoscaler sees AttachFailed errors for tenant pools, (3) add config-lint to terraform to prevent role condition removal on autoscaler principal.

rafael: will schedule the revert task and annotate billing notes for emergency attach. Also adding a short runbook note: when reserved pool attach fails due to IAM, treat as priority P0 and follow the temporary-role flow.

maya: handing to night oncall @li for watch. I'll sit on the postmortem.

li: ack, monitoring dashboards for 2h. Also scheduling postmortem meeting for tomorrow 0900 PT. Creating incident ticket INC-2167901111.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED  mitigated. Tags: dedicated-pool, tenant-tnr-501, iam-attach-failure, manual-perm-fix.

jess: after-action items added to backlog. Also suggest we proactively reach out to customers running large nightly batches to advise cadence/limits.

tina (acct): will notify Sparrow and join postmortem. They requested that we include a recommended configuration for batch windows to reduce risk.

maya: good work team. Closing thread; leave notes in ticket for handoff. :thumbsup:
